response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM grouped ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
